about_the_game:
WAR! is a Single Player, Top Down Third Person Shooter influenced by retro gaming.  Control a small squad of up to 4 soldiers through 20 missions.  Your soldiers are armed with rifles that can kill with a single round, however, so are your enemies.  Use caution as you explore each map as the enemy can use rocket launchers, rocket turrets and vehicles to stop you.  With each victory your number of available recruits will increase, with each defeat a heavy loss, your recruit reserves will dwindle. Remember, every recruit matters in your WAR!

Game Features

  • Control your soldier through forest, sand, and snow to find and kill your enemy!

  • Find the enemy base and destroy their buildings with Rockets and Grenades!

  • You can die from a single round or explosion so use caution!

  • Fight against superior numbers using planning and limited resources to achieve your objectives!

content_descriptors.notes: This game features violence with shooting, explosions, and blood  effects
